Cefteram Pivoxil (rINNM) Ceftéram, Pivoxil de; Cefteram pivoxilo; Cefterami Pivoxil; T- 2588. Pivaloyloxymethyl (Z)-7-[2-(2-aminothiazol-4-yl)-2-meth- oxyiminoacetamido]-3-(5-methyl-2H-tetrazol-2-ylmethyl)-3-ce- phem-4-carboxylic acid. Цефтерама Пивоксил C22H27N9O7S2 = 593.6. CAS — 82547-58-8 (cefteram); 82547-81-7 (cefteram pivoxil). (cefteram) Pharmacopoeias. In Jpn. Profile Cefteram is a cephalosporin antibacterial used for the treatment of susceptible infections. It is given orally as the pivaloyloxyme- thyl ester, cefteram pivoxil, and doses are expressed in terms of cefteram; 186 mg of cefteram pivoxil is equivalent to about 150 mg of cefteram. The usual dose is 150 to 300 mg daily in 3 divided doses after meals. For severe infections, up to 600 mg daily may be given. For reference to carnitine deficiency occurring after the adminis- tration of some pivaloyloxymethyl esters, see Pivampicillin, p.317.
